meta.title: SF 2040
meta.tagline: Forty-one days after Erebus. One rider, one horse, a city gone wild. Find them.
meta.blurb: Forty-one days after Erebus came down on the Presidio and the Bio-Preserve's walls fell, Cal Mercer, an ex-park ranger, rides his horse Ranger into a San Francisco gone wild to find his wife Nina and their daughter June. Scavenge Market Street, slip past what sleeps on it, round up a wild herd, get past the Preserve's security mech and stand up to the Iron Saints. Six missions, from the Embarcadero to the Presidio.

storykit.controls: In the saddle: W trots, hold Shift to gallop, Q slows to a walk, A and D turn, Space jumps, the mouse looks. J swings the bat at whoever is beside you and K kicks out behind. F gets down or back up; on foot J hits and Q counters. M opens the map, Esc pauses.
storykit.how: A story in three acts across San Francisco after the impact. Follow the objective and the yellow line on your map to each mission: rides, scavenging, a herd, creatures to sneak past or fight, a mech, and calls on the radio move the story on, with cutscenes between them. Between missions the city is yours to roam. Finish all six to bring the Mercers home.
